name: Carbonite
description_en:
Carbonite by OpenText offers cloud backup for personal computers and separate professional/server products. Carbonite Safe protects selected user files and supports file restoration; a plan called unlimited does not imply every file, drive or server is automatically included.

This profile concentrates on Safe personal plans. The official FAQ separates Safe Pro and Server Backup, so business or server requirements need their own quote and implementation check. No account, installation or restore was tested.
description_zh:
Carbonite by OpenText 提供个人电脑云备份，另有专业和服务器产品。Carbonite Safe 保护所选用户文件并支持恢复；“无限”不表示所有文件、硬盘或服务器自动包含。

本文重点介绍 Safe 个人套餐。官方 FAQ 将 Safe Pro 和 Server Backup 分开，因此商用或服务器需求需单独询价和核对实现。本次未测试账户、安装或恢复。

sections.title_en: Verify selected files in the matching client
sections.title_zh: 在匹配客户端中核对所选文件
sections.en:
The Mac 2.x guide uses the Back Up view and Select Files for Backup to add a file or folder, then reports whether it could be added. Some parent folders, including Home and the whole user Library, cannot be selected as a unit even when individual items can. A location appearing in Finder alone does not establish selection.

For example, test an important document directory and one application’s hidden data separately, then inspect backup status after upload. Use the article for the installed client version: Mac 1.x instructions and Windows controls are different. This suggested check was not performed.
sections.zh:
Mac 2.x 指南通过 Back Up 和 Select Files for Backup 添加文件或文件夹，再报告是否能添加。Home 及整个用户 Library 等父目录不能整项选择，即使其中单个项目可以选。在 Finder 看得到，并不证明已纳入备份。

例如，应分别检查重要文档目录和某个应用的隐藏数据，上传后核对备份状态。文档需匹配已安装客户端；Mac 1.x 和 Windows 的控制不同。本文未实际执行这一建议检查。

sections.title_en: Recover files and then validate their application
sections.title_zh: 恢复文件后还要核对应用使用
sections.en:
The Windows restore overview distinguishes restoring all files on a new or repaired computer, restoring selected large files through the installed application, and downloading small files through the account. It notes that some applications need an import procedure before restored data behaves as expected.

A useful evaluation restores a sample document and an application data set to a spare location, opens both in the relevant program and compares contents. Download completion is only one acceptance point. The FAQ also limits subscription transfers to the same platform, so a Windows-to-Mac replacement needs a specific migration decision.
sections.zh:
Windows 恢复概览区分新电脑或修复电脑上的全部文件恢复、通过已装应用恢复所选大文件，以及通过账户下载小文件。它还提醒某些应用需执行导入，恢复的数据才能正常使用。

评估可把样例文档和应用数据恢复到备用位置，用相关程序打开并比较内容；下载完成只是一个验收点。FAQ 还限定订阅在相同平台之间转移，因此 Windows 换 Mac 需单独确认迁移方式。

sections.title_en: Read annual promotions as annual offers
sections.title_zh: 按年付优惠理解宣传月价
sections.en:
The retrieved homepage advertises discounted annual totals: Basic USD 76.79/year, Plus USD 85.79/year and Prime USD 105.29/year, alongside rounded monthly equivalents. It lists regular annual reference amounts of USD 95.99, USD 131.99 and USD 161.99. These are promotion snapshots, not verified renewal quotes.

Basic lists one computer, while Plus and Prime list one computer plus one external drive. Video automation and courier recovery are plan-sensitive. Confirm the selected OS, feature matrix, tax, promotional eligibility and renewal price at checkout. Do not present the rounded USD 6.40 monthly display as a monthly cancellable charge.
sections.zh:
读取时首页展示优惠年付总额：Basic 每年 76.79 美元、Plus 每年 85.79 美元、Prime 每年 105.29 美元，旁边为四舍五入的月均值；原价参考分别为每年 95.99、131.99 和 161.99 美元。这是优惠快照，未确认续费报价。

Basic 列一台电脑，Plus 和 Prime 列一台电脑加一块外置盘。自动视频备份和快递恢复也随套餐不同。结账时应确认系统、矩阵、税费、优惠资格和续费价，不能把月均 6.40 美元写成可逐月取消的扣款。

sections.title_en: Coverage and retention require a specific check
sections.title_zh: 覆盖和保留期需具体核查
sections.en:
The older Mac 1.x selection page documents excluded system, program and temporary files, plus plan and filesystem conditions for additional drives. It is retained here as version-specific evidence, not a claim that all its details apply to the current client. The newer guide reinforces that selecting a parent is not enough for every location.

Shortlist Safe for file-oriented computer protection when the exact folders and drive allowance fit. For server recovery, managed business policy, or bare-metal recovery, evaluate the corresponding product rather than assuming personal Safe includes it. Current deleted-file retention, courier availability, failure escalation and full license terms were not established by this reading.
sections.zh:
较旧 Mac 1.x 页面记载系统、程序和临时文件排除项，以及额外硬盘的套餐及文件系统条件。本文保留为特定版本依据，不能把全部细节推广到当前客户端；较新指南同样说明选择父目录并不能覆盖每个位置。

当具体文件夹和硬盘额度匹配时，可把 Safe 列为电脑文件保护候选。服务器恢复、商用集中策略或裸机恢复需核对对应产品，不能假定个人 Safe 包含。本次未确认当前已删文件保留期、快递适用性、故障升级及完整许可。
